subject: Kestrel Health — VPC commissioning runway & sprint coordination
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@kestrelhealth.com>, procurement@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel kickoff — VPC details and gating doc

Hi Vivek / Redwood team,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. We're ready to start the private deployment kickoff for our production VPC — goal is to have an internal pilot by end of June. Before we lock dates, our infra team needs a clear list of preflight requirements and the minimal artifacts they'll need from our side.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you send a single checklist (network + KMS + IAM + egress) we can attach to our change request?
- Any constraints on CIDR / shared services?
- If there are standard templates (CloudFormation / Terraform / YAML) that accelerates provisioning, please share.

I've attached the gap matrix our security team uses (SAQ.pdf) and a short inventory sheet (kestrel_infra_ask.xlsx) that we'll fill out.

Attachments: SAQ.pdf (pdf), kestrel_infra_ask.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Eng Programs
Kestrel Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel kickoff — VPC details and gating doc

Sam — thanks for the packet and timeline. I'm copying Kimberly (security & onboarding) and Grace (ops) so we can land a practical runbook. Below is the starter checklist and the immediate asks we need from your infra team to begin sprint-0.

Starter runbook (summary):
1) Account & access
   - Root account alias + payer account ID (for reserved capacity mapping)
   - List of engineer IAM ARNs for initial access (bastion and service accounts)
2) Network
   - VPC CIDR(s) (primary / secondary), expected max pod/node counts, and NAT egress pattern
   - Any existing shared services (DNS, AD, logging) that must be peered or routed
3) Crypto & secrets
   - Preferred KMS provider & key ARNs (or we can provision policy-suggested keys)
4) Observability & audit
   - Forwarding endpoint for audit logs (S3 bucket or syslog) and retention policy
5) Compliance evidence
   - SAQ + any internal evidence for SOC-like items (we'll map to our control set)

Deliverables we'll provide in response:
- Redwood private onboarding sprint outline (PDF) — see attached
- Example network template (initial_network_template.yaml) for your infra team to adapt
- A short 'minimum viable host' checklist for pilot traffic generation

Attachments: redwood_private_onboarding_sprint.pdf (pdf), initial_network_template.yaml (yaml)

Proposed next step: 30-min tech handoff (Deep-dive) — I can do Friday 05/21 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works, Kimberly will cover security gating and Grace will review observability hooks.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@kestrelhealth.com>, procurement@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:53:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel kickoff — VPC details and gating doc

Thanks Vivek — that checklist is exactly what we needed. Here's what I can share immediately (filled from kestrel_infra_ask.xlsx):
- Primary VPC CIDR: 10.100.0.0/16 (we'll reserve 10.101.0.0/16 for staging)
- Expected peak nodes: ~40 (initial pilot 8–12)
- Egress: NAT via centralized NAT gateway in the shared-services account; outbound IPs tied to static Elastic IP pool (we'll provide the list)
- KMS: We use AWS KMS, key alias: alias/kestrel-rd; Priya is our infrastructure lead for keys and networking.
- Logging: Central S3 bucket kestrel-prod-logs (us-east-1), retention: 365 days

Priya's contact: Priya Desai <priya.desai@kestrelhealth.com> — she'll be on the handoff call. Procurement will review the order form after tech review (procurement@kestrelhealth.com).

Meeting: Friday 21 May at 10:00 AM PT works. I'll invite Priya and our infra lead.

Subject: Re: Kestrel kickoff — VPC details and gating doc

Sam / team — quick security notes ahead of today's handoff:
- KMS: we'll need either the KMS key policy or a cross-account grant for the Redwood service principal; if using your alias, please add the grant for account 123456789012 (Redwood tenant account) ahead of the call.
- Egress allowlist: please provide the static EIP list at least 48 hours before traffic tests so we can add to our egress SAFELIST in staging.
- DLP & PHI: since Kestrel handles PHI, we will enable strict transcription redaction by default for the pilot. We'll need an exception form if you want raw transcripts.

I've uploaded a short security QNA we use as a gating artifact (link below) — please have your security SME answer the ten quick questions prior to go/no-go. If procurement needs it, we can sign a standard order form during the call; DocuSign link will be ready after technical acceptance.

Perfect — thanks Sam / Priya. Quick recap and next steps from Redwood: 
- Today (Fri 21 May) 10:00 AM PT: 30m tech handoff (invite sent) — agenda: network walk, KMS grant verification, logging hookup, smoke test plan.
- Precall (you): post the static EIP list and grant preview to the shared Drive by EOD today (we'll validate 48h before traffic).
- Deliverables (by Redwood within 48 hours post-call): customized onboarding runbook, pilot test plan, and DocuSign order form for pilot capacity.
- Security: Kimberly will run the gating QNA; Priya please assign someone to complete the 10-question doc before the scheduled acceptance window.

If anything blocks the Friday slot, flag now — otherwise we'll proceed and treat this as Sprint-0 kickoff toward pilot in mid-June.
